title: Natural person identity data and verification boundaries
flow: Create individual profile with consent/legal basis and data minimization
Validate local name/script/date conventions without invented mandatory IDs
Obtain evidence from permitted customer channel or official verifier
Check document validity, expiration and duplicate identity candidates
Escalate mismatch, vulnerability or minor/guardian cases to authorized review
Issue an evidence-backed identity state while preserving source attribution
rules: Declared identity and officially verified identity are distinct claim types
Do not store biometric templates, document scans or government IDs without explicit lawful policy
Store sensitive documents under separate encryption/access and retention controls
Verification success for one document cannot automatically verify all identity claims
Permit corrections through immutable reviewed events instead of overwriting the evidence trail
Do not infer nationality, legal residency or sanctions status from a phone number or name
acceptance_cases: Expired proof cannot satisfy current policy
Missing required consent/legal basis blocks optional sensitive processing
Mismatch between declared and evidenced birth date triggers review
Cross-tenant access to document metadata rejected
Correction creates immutable before/after audit record
review_gate: Institution KYC policy, local privacy advice, permitted identity verification source and accessible review workflow.
